objects.description: [TrickBot](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0266) can obtain passwords stored in files from several applications such as Outlook, Filezilla, OpenSSH, OpenVPN and WinSCP.(Citation: Trend Micro Trickbot Nov 2018)(Citation: Cyberreason Anchor December 2019) Additionally, it searches for the ".vnc.lnk" affix to steal VNC credentials.(Citation: TrendMicro Trickbot Feb 2019)
